statement:
∀ (T : ℝ) (V : Set (Quotient (angleSetoid T))) (U : Set ℝ),
  IsOpen U →
    (IsOpen V ↔ IsOpen (Quotient.mk (angleSetoid T) ⁻¹' V)) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Quotient.mk (angleSetoid T) ⁻¹' V, x + T ∈ Quotient.mk (angleSetoid T) ⁻¹' V) ∧
        Quotient.mk (angleSetoid T) ⁻¹' Quotient.mk (angleSetoid T) '' U = ⋃ k, (fun x => x + ↑k * T) '' U ∧
          IsOpen (Quotient.mk (angleSetoid T) '' U)

# name: set-quotient-open-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.QuotientTopology.quotient_open_sets
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['2 * Real.pi', 'Set.univ', 'Set.Ioo 0 1', 'isOpen_Ioo'], False, "have key : ∀ (T : ℝ) (V : Set (Quotient (angleSetoid T))) (U : Set ℝ) (hU : IsOpen U), (IsOpen V ↔ IsOpen (Quotient.mk (angleSetoid T) ⁻¹' V)) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Quotient.mk (angleSetoid T) ⁻¹' V, x + T ∈ Quotient.mk (angleSetoid T) ⁻¹' V) ∧ Quotient.mk (angleSetoid T) ⁻¹' (Quotient.mk (angleSetoid T) '' U) = ⋃ k : ℤ, (fun x => x + k * T) '' U ∧ IsOpen (Quotient.mk (angleSetoid T) '' U) := by
  intro T V U hU
  have hpre : Quotient.mk (angleSetoid T) ⁻¹' (Quotient.mk (angleSetoid T) '' U) =
      ⋃ k : ℤ, (fun x => x + k * T) '' U := by
    ext y
    simp only [mem_preimage, mem_image, mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Quotient.exact hxy
      exact ⟨k, x, hx, by linarith⟩
    · rintro ⟨k, x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨x, hx, Quotient.sound ⟨k, by ring⟩⟩
  refine ⟨Iff.symm isQuotientMap_quotient_mk'.isOpen_preimage, fun x hx => ?_, hpre, ?_⟩
  · simp only [mem_preimage] at hx ⊢
    rwa [Quotient.sound (show angleSetoid T x (x + T) from ⟨1, by simp⟩)] at hx
  · have h : IsOpen (Quotient.mk (angleSetoid T) ⁻¹' (Quotient.mk (angleSetoid T) '' U)) := by
      rw [hpre]
      exact isOpen_iUnion fun k => (Homeomorph.addRight ((k : ℝ) * T)).isOpenMap U hU
    exact isQuotientMap_quotient_mk'.isOpen_preimage.1 h

    (['1', 'Set.univ', 'Set.Ioo (-1) 1', 'isOpen_Ioo'], False, "have key : ∀ (T : ℝ) (V : Set (Quotient (angleSetoid T))) (U : Set ℝ) (hU : IsOpen U), (IsOpen V ↔ IsOpen (Quotient.mk (angleSetoid T) ⁻¹' V)) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Quotient.mk (angleSetoid T) ⁻¹' V, x + T ∈ Quotient.mk (angleSetoid T) ⁻¹' V) ∧ Quotient.mk (angleSetoid T) ⁻¹' (Quotient.mk (angleSetoid T) '' U) = ⋃ k : ℤ, (fun x => x + k * T) '' U ∧ IsOpen (Quotient.mk (angleSetoid T) '' U) := by
